pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Haul Away Junk Removal is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A friendly two-person crew loading an old couch into a junk-removal truck

children: We started Haul Away to make getting rid of stuff the easy part of your day. Show up on time, quote an honest flat price, do all the lifting, and leave the space cleaner than we found it.

We’re a friendly, local crew that hauls furniture, appliances, garage and estate cleanouts and construction debris — for homeowners, landlords, contractors and anyone with a pile that needs to disappear. No hourly meter, no upsells, no runaround.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We look at the job, quote the space it takes in the truck, and hand you a flat written price. Nothing moves until you say go.
You never have to drag anything to the curb. We carry it out from wherever it sits — stairs, basements, back yards and all.
We sweep up behind us and haul everything off in the same visit. You’re left with an empty, tidy space and nothing to deal with.
